content.short: Blum is a Telegram-native crypto trading ecosystem with perps, a memepad, and a trading terminal.
content.description: Blum is a crypto trading ecosystem built around Telegram. Its public site presents perps trading, a memecoin launchpad called Memepad, and a trading terminal that lets users trade tokens without leaving the Telegram-centered experience. It belongs in the TON set because its product is designed for Telegram users and routes crypto trading, launches, and rewards through that channel. Blum is a game listing because users interact through play, progression, competition, collectibles, rewards, or community challenges.
